target_users.interface: calendar APIs, CalDAV, and Workflow triggers
iCal/CalDAV invite acceptance from non-Connect calendar clients

acceptance_criteria.given: a work calendar event is created
acceptance_criteria.then: event is Org pillar, tenant-DEK encrypted, retention-classed, and audit logged

acceptance_criteria.when: an org admin queries availability details
acceptance_criteria.then: policy returns only allowed free/busy projection or 403 for details

acceptance_criteria.given: a work event contains an approval action card
acceptance_criteria.then: Workflow receives a policy-gated handoff and WorkflowHandoffAuditLog links event, action, consent/policy basis

acceptance_criteria.given: a professional calendar event is under legal hold
acceptance_criteria.then: event, attendee history, action cards, and audit chain are preserved

acceptance_criteria.given: a tenant has KR/EU/US policy overlays
acceptance_criteria.then: the selected retention window stays inside jurisdiction bounds and is visible in admin UX

acceptance_criteria.given: an external attendee uses a non-Connect calendar client (Apple Calendar, Google Calendar, Outlook)
acceptance_criteria.when: they receive or accept an invite
acceptance_criteria.then: the invite is delivered as RFC 5545 iCal and CalDAV RSVP is accepted; the attendee status is reflected in the work event

acceptance_criteria.given: a user creates a work event with attendees in multiple time zones
acceptance_criteria.then: each attendee sees the event in their local time zone; IANA time zone IDs are stored on the event; display converts without ambiguity; DST transitions are handled correctly

acceptance_criteria.given: a user invokes the scheduling assistant to find a meeting time
acceptance_criteria.then: it uses minimum-necessary free/busy projection across pillar boundaries; personal calendar details are never exposed; suggested slots are returned within working-hours policy

acceptance_criteria.given: a work event is created with a video call
acceptance_criteria.then: a native video-call link is auto-generated and embedded in the event; the link is tied to the event lifecycle (cancelled/rescheduled events invalidate the link)

acceptance_criteria.given: a user sets up a public appointment booking page
acceptance_criteria.when: an external visitor books a slot
acceptance_criteria.then: the booking creates a work event in the host's calendar with explicit pillar tag; visitor sees only available slots based on free/busy projection; no personal details exposed

acceptance_criteria.given: a user configures working hours and focus time
acceptance_criteria.when: the scheduling assistant or booking page queries availability
acceptance_criteria.then: focus time blocks appear as busy and no meetings are scheduled outside working hours unless user explicitly overrides

industry_patterns_adopted.description: CalDAV (RFC 4791) server for external calendar clients; iCal (RFC 5545) for invite/event interchange; RSVP via CalDAV or email iTIP
industry_patterns_adopted.implemented_as: AC-06 + CalendarExternalRsvpReceived event + ical_rfc5545_round_trip_pct metric; stable wave

industry_patterns_adopted.description: IANA tz database IDs mandatory; all times stored as UTC + IANA ID; display conversion at query time; DST-aware slot computation; ambiguity warning near DST transitions

industry_patterns_adopted.source: Google Calendar Gemini scheduling, Outlook Scheduling Assistant
industry_patterns_adopted.description: Scheduling assistant queries free/busy projection only; personal calendar details never included; working hours and focus time respected; AI slot suggestions in GA wave with DEK-bounded opt-in
industry_patterns_adopted.implemented_as: AC-08 + AC-11 + AvailabilityProjection.projection_kind + WorkingHoursPolicy entity; stable wave

industry_patterns_adopted.source: Google Calendar focus time/auto-decline, Outlook working hours, Apple Focus modes
industry_patterns_adopted.description: User configures working hours and focus time blocks; these appear as busy to scheduling assistant and booking pages; no inference from personal calendar

industry_patterns_adopted.source: Google Meet (Google Calendar), Microsoft Teams (Outlook Calendar)
industry_patterns_adopted.description: Work events auto-generate a native video-call link on creation; link is tied to event lifecycle; cancelled events invalidate the link
industry_patterns_adopted.implemented_as: AC-09 + VideoCallLink entity + CalendarVideoCallLinkInvalidated event; stable wave

industry_patterns_adopted.description: Public or policy-gated booking pages expose only free/busy slots; host personal details never visible; booking creates a work event with explicit pillar tag
industry_patterns_adopted.implemented_as: AC-10 + BookingPage entity + CalendarBookingPageSlotTaken event; GA wave

industry_patterns_adopted.source: Google Calendar Time Insights, Microsoft Viva Insights
industry_patterns_adopted.description: Meeting analytics and schedule analysis operate on work context only; personal calendar data is never included; org admins see aggregated insights not individual event details
